note: Rewritten from the original description by Kemner (1930); the measurement table in the German original is partly damaged by OCR, so only legible alate and soldier measurements are given; worker measurements omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates distinctly larger than those of Cryptotermes domesticus, body with wings 10.30–11.00 mm; soldier head with mandibles 1.62–1.66 mm, body 3.50–4.50 mm, mandibles longer than in C. domesticus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior half of head capsule deep black, posterior half yellowish brown; mandibles black; antennae and palpi pale yellowish brown. Head subquadrate, slightly wider than high; anterior margin deeply incised into two raised lobes separated by a deep groove, with a rounded depression behind. Antennae 12-segmented. Pronotum with anterior margin upturned and angularly incised, posterior margin straight. Fore tibia with 3 apical spurs, the third small and smooth. Body 3.50–4.50 mm; head with mandibles 1.62–1.66 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body white, mandible tips brown. Left mandible with two shallow basal notches and a distinct tooth in the outer third; right mandible with two small blunt teeth on the inner margin, the basal one near mid-length. Body length and head width vary with instar.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body yellowish brown, head, pronotum and abdominal tergites darker, venter paler. Head oval, distinctly longer than wide; frons shallowly depressed; compound eyes large; ocelli small and oblique. Antennae 15-segmented. Pronotum distinctly incised anteriorly, rounded posteriorly, nearly straight at the middle. Wings hyaline, only the costal margin and veins yellowish brown; forewing radial sector with 7 anterior branches, media meeting the radial sector beyond mid-wing, cubitus with about 14 branches; hindwing radial sector with 3 anterior branches. Body with wings 10.30–11.00 mm; forewing including scale 9.20–9.60 mm.
